name: Robin Gomes
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember watching my old hair collect in the hospital basin.” Wednesday often includes a stop at Ferris Deli, where Robin asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I wanted my old photograph. In the chair I saw how much I like this new cowlick.
appearance: Robin has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Look for a cropped cut that shows the shape of the ears. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a brown corduroy jacket with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it. In conversation Robin gives a little nod before asking a hard question.
personality: Robin enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To choose a haircut that honors the new texture.
family: Talia Carvalho is Robin’s half-sibling. Robin chooses whether to use it. Talia saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The ladder crossing*, Talia says, “I balanced my shopping on a rung while we waited.”
connections: Ivy Arnett (stylist). The client talks to the stylist about what to keep of the new texture.

reactions.situation: Someone asks to take a photograph before the haircut
reactions.response: Robin waits for the customer's permission before anyone takes a picture.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Robin says what they know in their own name and refuses to treat a guess as something the child has to disprove.
